identity: A white-black control deck built on a scalable wrath. Zero Point Ballad reads 'Destroy all creatures with toughness X or less. You lose X life. If X is 6 or more, return a creature card put into a graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control' - so it is a sweeper that can also hand you the best creature it just killed, including the opponent's. White covers what a toughness-capped wrath misses with unconditional exile. The recursion here is not the usual creature reanimation: Scrounge for Eternity returns SPACECRAFT as well as creatures, Fell Gravship rebuys Spacecraft to hand, and Rescue Skiff returns a creature OR ENCHANTMENT - which means it rebuys Banishing Light and re-exiles a second permanent. Dawnstrike Vanguard's toughness 5 is chosen so it survives this deck's own Ballad at any X of 4 or less.

Basic lands are format-supplied and exempt.
